text:
anya: did a quick cross-region run comparing A100 vs H100 for Llama-2-13B and Mistral-7B. weird kernel fallbacks in eu-west for 13B quantized, and cost math doesn't match intuition. any thoughts? :thinking_face:

michael: can you paste the prefills vs decode breakdown? especially p50/p99 and tokens/sec per GPU SKU.

anya: sure, pasted minimal table below. numbers are median over 10 short-chat traces (avg prompt ~80 tokens, generation ~120 tokens). quantization = 4-bit (q4_k_m).

```
model, region, gpu, prefill_ms(p50), decode_ms(p50), tokens_per_sec, $/1M_tokens
llama-2-13b, us-west-2, a100, 85, 240, 320, 6.8
llama-2-13b, us-west-2, h100, 72, 190, 420, 9.1
llama-2-13b, eu-west-1, a100, 98, 260, 300, 7.6
llama-2-13b, eu-west-1, h100, 105, 210, 390, 10.0  # NOTE: prefill slower, kernel fallback observed
mistral-7b, us-west-2, a100, 48, 110, 920, 2.3
mistral-7b, us-west-2, h100, 40, 95, 1100, 2.9
```

anya: eu-west H100 shows higher prefill_ms than A100 which is backwards. logs show fallback from `launch_attn_fused` -> `generic_attention_v1` on H100 nodes in eu-west.

sanjay: that sounds like a kernel selection mismatch. did the runtime pick cuBLAS-based matmul or custom tensor core kernels? can we share the kernel tags from the run?

anya: grabbed kernel tags from the profile on one H100 host: `kernels: [custom_attn_fused_v2, tensorcore_gemm, generic_attention_v1]` then for the slow traces it switches to `generic_attention_v1` (no tensor cores). suspect driver+cuda combo on that zone.

lucy: quick checklist: 1) driver versions differ across regions? 2) runtime env (RAPIDS/CUDA_PATCH) mismatch? 3) SMT or MIG config?

anya: drivers: us-west-2 H100 nodes = 535.86, eu-west-1 H100 nodes = 530.30. A100 nodes are 535.86 across zones. so eu-west H100s are older drivers.

michael: that could explain it. older driver falls back to slower kernels. evict policy also different? if prefill slower, p99 will blow up under burst.

deploy-bot: uploaded full artifact: s3://redwood-eval/bench/1768123456/h100-eu-profile.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

anya: ran a quick cost recompute assuming reserved pricing: we use tokens/sec -> instance count -> $/1M tokens. these are ballpark but useful for capacity sizing. H100 gives ~30% decode throughput uplift for 13B but costs ~35% more per token in our reserved pricing because instance price delta > throughput delta. for Mistral-7B H100 is win for latency but cheaper per token on A100 when heavily quantized.

sanjay: TLDR recommendation: pin kernel constraints or force driver upgrade on eu-west H100 fleet. For short-term cap planning, use A100 for heavy quantized 13B workloads in eu-west; H100 in us-west where drivers are current.

michael: also surface a rollout policy: add a kernel-sanity check in model onboarding (fail if prefills on H100 are > A100 by >15% for same quant config). helps avoid silent regressions.

anya: agreed. i'll open a tiny PR to add the check to onboarding pipeline + an infra ticket to upgrade drivers in eu-west. leaving notes in the artifact about which traces used for regression tests. thanks :thumbsup:

lucy: can you tag infra once PR is up? i'll help test the driver patch on a small canary H100 host.

anya: will do, tagging @infra in PR body.

michael: nice. once infra confirms, re-run the eu-west H100 profile and we can re-evaluate $/1M tokens and update the model catalog performance notes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

anya: logging action items in the PR and posting follow-up results in this thread.
